trigger_damage.desc: Trigger that responds to taking damage. Damage trigger will trigger if a bullet intersects them or if a projectile or grenade explodes inside the trigger.

PISTOL_NO.desc: turns off response to pistol damage

RIFLE_NO.desc: turns off response to rifle damage

PROJ_NO.desc: turns off response to projectile damage from grenades and rockets. Note that turning off projectile damage will also turn off splash damage, whether or not the splash is on.

SPLASH_NO.desc: turns off response to splash damage from grenades and rockets.

MELEE_NO.desc: turns off response to melee damage

FIRE_NO.desc: turns off response to flame/fire damage

MISC_NO.desc: turns off response to all other misc types of damage

wait.desc: -1 = one time only, otherwise triggers every frame.

accumulate.desc: If set, this much damage must be accumulated before it will trigger. Note that accumulate & threshold can used at the same time.

threshold.desc: If set, the min amount of damage that must be done to it to trigger it. Note that accumulate & threshold can used at the same time.

node_negotiation_begin.desc:
Must target a single "node_negotiation_end".
Always contributes to navigation data.
Can never be included in a friendly chain.

STOP_FIRST.desc: if set, the AI comes to a complete stop before starting the node's animation script

CHOKE_POINT.desc: node is randomly expensive to use

PROCEDURAL.desc: AI should procedurally jump to the target node, without using an animation.

WALLRUN.desc: node connects to a wallrun clip

AIRBORNE.desc: node is used by flying AI, not by ground AI

animscript.desc: name without path or extension of the animation script to play when you reach this node.  This script must be in "animscripts/traverse/".

movementtype_ignore.desc: movementtypes that cannot use this node

movementtype_require.desc: movementtypes that an actor must have to use this node

width.desc: used to generate a user edge in navmesh. AI can perform a traversal along the edge instead of just on the node

cost_modifier.desc: Cost modifier to apply to this traversal during run-time astar searches

node_negotiation_end.desc:
Must be targeted by a "node_negotiation_begin".
Always contributes to navigation data.
Can never be included in a friendly chain.

PROCEDURAL.desc: AI should procedurally jump to the target node, without using an animation.

WALLRUN.desc: node connects to a wallrun clip

AIRBORNE.desc: node is used by flying AI, not by ground AI

width.desc: used to generate a user edge in navmesh. AI can perform a traversal along the edge instead of just on the node

navigation_reference.procedural_behavior_requirement: zm_genesis_zombie includes the procedural branch; the default ZombieTraverseBehavior uses animation traversal instead
navigation_reference.scope: Installed animation table mappings, zombie script predicate and editor flags; no compiled gameplay validation

fields.name: nonColliding
fields.tooltip: No collision data is ever stored in the BSP, saving memory and CPU in the game.

fields.name: nonSolid
fields.tooltip: Nothing collides with this surface, but it still generates collision data.  Use 'nonColliding' if possible.

fields.name: transparent
fields.tooltip: This material isn't a boundary for portals, and geometry on the other side of it won't get deleted.

fields.name: detail
fields.tooltip: This material will never split the BSP in the map compiler.  This is usually set in the editor instead.

fields.name: structural
fields.tooltip: This material will split the BSP in the map compiler by default.  This can be overridden in the editor.

fields.name: portal
fields.tooltip: This material is a runtime portal.  The edges of brush faces using this material will cull geometry.

fields.name: lightPortal
fields.tooltip: This material starts a new region of influence for a primary light.  It doesn't split the BSP.

fields.name: lightDemoteHint
fields.tooltip: This material hints that a primary light on one side should become a secondary light on the other side.

fields.name: origin
fields.tooltip: If a brush model entity has a brush with this material, the entity's origin is the center of that brush instead of the world origin.
